authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/korg/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/korg/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a control change the document says the instrument recognises, or a row of its NRPN table, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Not a parameter here, Bank Select, part of preset recall: CC 0, 32.
Not a parameter here, Data Entry, part of the NRPN messages: CC 6.
Not a parameter here, an NRPN or RPN selector, part of the NRPN messages: CC 98, 99.
Not a parameter here, a channel mode message: CC 120, 121, 123, 124, 125, 126, 127.

Left out, the NRPNs repeat settings the SysEx parameter change reaches in full: NRPN 00 02H, 00 03H, 00 04H, 00 07H, 00 0AH, 04 00H, 04 01H, 04 02H, 04 03H, 04 08H, 04 09H, 04 0AH, 04 0BH, 04 10H, 04 12H, 04 14H, 04 16H, 04 18H, 04 1AH, 04 1CH, 04 1EH, 04 20H, 04 22H, 04 24H, 04 26H, 04 28H, 04 2AH, 04 2CH, 04 2EH.

204 parameter(s) by SysEx PARAMETER CHANGE (F0 42 3g 00 01 40 41 pp PP vv VV F7): the Param ID and the value 14 bits each, low seven first. A setting printed 64+/-n is sent as its signed value, -n - +n, which is how this profile reads NOTE 5's "VVvv = signed value"; not yet tried on an instrument.
Left out, a run of IDs for the bits of one setting: Program Name (00:00~0B), Trigger Pattern (00:30~37).
Left out, the value is printed as "64=0": Vel.Sense.
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH LEVEL [0]": CH LEVEL [1].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH LEVEL [2]": CH LEVEL [3].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH LEVEL [4]": CH LEVEL [5].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH LEVEL [6]": CH LEVEL [7].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH LEVEL [8]": CH LEVEL [9].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH LEVEL [10]": CH LEVEL [11].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH LEVEL [12]": CH LEVEL [13].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH LEVEL [14]": CH LEVEL [15].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH PAN [0]": CH PAN [1].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH PAN [2]": CH PAN [3].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH PAN [4]": CH PAN [5].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH PAN [6]": CH PAN [7].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH PAN [8]": CH PAN [9].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH PAN [10]": CH PAN [11].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH PAN [12]": CH PAN [13].
Left out, the value is printed as "= CH PAN [14]": CH PAN [15].
The exclusive header carries the global MIDI channel as 3g; the profile's deviceId variable is that byte, 30H for channel 1.
